title: Chio Capability Revocation Entry
description: A single revocation entry. Its target is one of the closed target kinds of PROTOCOL 5.6.7; `capability_id` revokes that capability and every descendant, the other kinds revoke every anchored root they match. Subject and tenant targets are stored as tags, never as plaintext. Operators write entries through `/admin/revocations`; a denied call's receipt names the matching `entry_id` in its guard evidence. Mirrors the kernel revocation store row. Introduced with anchored roots (PROTOCOL 5.6).

entry_id.description: Stable revocation entry id returned to the admin and named in deny receipts.

target.description: A capability `id`, a root policy `rule_id`, a subject tag, a tenant tag, or the `replay_key_digest` of one assertion, per `target_kind`.

revoked_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the revocation took effect. Stored as a signed integer in the kernel store; negative values are not produced by the issuer but are not rejected here in order to match the Rust `i64` shape.

target.description: Keyed index tag in its string form, `<prefix>1.<hex key_id>.<hex value>`: `st` for `anchor_subject`, `tt` for `tenant_tag`.
